entries.name: Jeweled Lotus
entries.description: Your units' abilities can critically strike. Gain 15% Critical Strike Chance.

entries.name: Rich Get Richer
entries.description: Gain 1 interest gold every round. Max interest increased by 2.

entries.name: Pandora's Items
entries.description: Round start: items on your bench are randomized.

entries.name: Trade Sector
entries.description: Gain a free shop refresh every round.

entries.name: Cybernetic Uplink
entries.description: Your champions holding an item gain 120 Health and restore 2 Mana per second.

entries.name: Binary Airdrop
entries.description: Your champions equipped with 2 items temporarily gain a random completed item at the start of combat.

entries.name: Thrill of the Hunt
entries.description: Your units heal 350 Health on kill.

entries.name: Portable Forge
entries.description: Choose 1 of 3 Artifacts and gain the item.

entries.name: Last Stand
entries.description: The first time you would be eliminated, instead remain in the game with 1 HP.

entries.name: Hustler
entries.description: You earn 3 additional gold every 4 rounds.

entries.name: Combat Training
entries.description: Your champions gain 5% Attack Damage and Ability Power for each combat they survive.

entries.name: Radiant Relics
entries.description: Choose 1 of 5 Radiant items and gain the item.

entries.name: Built Different
entries.description: Your units with no Traits active gain 250 Health and 30% Attack Speed.

entries.name: Wise Spending
entries.description: Gain 2 gold and a free shop refresh every time you level up.
